# School of the Future — Techno India University

> School of the Future (SoF) is an industry-powered academic initiative by Techno India University, Kolkata. It offers future-ready undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs co-designed with Google Cloud and IBM, featuring embedded certifications, live industry projects, and guaranteed internships.

## About

- Official Name: Techno India University (TIU)
- Initiative: School of the Future (SoF)
- Location: EM-4, Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal 700091, India
- Founded: 2012
- Phone: +91-8062642222
- Email: admissions@technoindiauniversity.com
- Website: https://www.technoindiauniversity.ai
- Accreditations: UGC, NAAC, AICTE, AIU
- Industry Partners: Google Cloud, IBM
- Google Cloud Case Study: https://cloud.google.com/customers/techno-india-university

## Programs Offered

### Engineering & Computer Science (UG)
- B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
- B.Tech CSE – AI/ML
- B.Tech CSE – Data Science
- B.Tech CSE – Cloud Computing

### Engineering & Computer Science (PG)
- M.Tech CSE – AI/ML

### Data Science & IT (UG)
- BCA with Data Science & AI
- B.Sc (H) Data Analytics & Generative AI
- B.Sc (H) Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking

### Data Science & IT (PG/PhD)
- M.Sc in Data Science & AI
- Ph.D in AI

### Business & Management
- BBA Business Analytics & AI
- MBA Business Analytics & AI
- BBA Hotel & Hospitality Management
- Executive MBA

### Design
- B.Des Visual Communication & Digital Design
- B.Des Game Art & Design
- B.Des Digital Product Design
- M.Des Advertising, Design & Digital Communication

### Media & Creative Arts
- B.Sc (H) in Sound Engineering
- B.Sc (H) in Game Development
- B.Sc (H) in Filmmaking
- B.Sc (H) in Visual Effects & Animation

### Allied Health Sciences
- B.Sc (H) Cardiovascular Technology
- B.Sc (H) Anesthesia and Operation Theater Technology
- Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT)
- Master of Medical Laboratory Technology (MMLT)
- Bachelor of Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology (BMRIT)
- Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)
- Master of Physiotherapy (MPT)

## Key Differentiators

- All programs include embedded Google Cloud and IBM certifications
- Curriculum co-designed with industry professionals
- Guaranteed internships with 500+ hiring partners
- Live industry projects integrated into coursework
- Located in Kolkata's IT hub (Salt Lake Sector V), adjacent to offices of TCS, Cognizant, IBM, and Wipro
- State-of-the-art campus with modern labs and facilities

Admissions are currently open for the 2026 academic year. Prospective students can apply online through the admissions page or contact the admissions office directly at +91-8062642222.
